cc:Work.dc:title: communication-study-angle-modulation
cc:Work.dc:description: Analytic single-tone comparison: fm=1 kHz, kf=2000 Hz per message unit and kp=2 rad per message unit. FM phase=2 sin(2 pi fm t), PM phase=2 cos(2 pi fm t); corresponding deviations are 2 kHz cos and -2 kHz sin. FM carrier short window fc=12 kHz has constant amplitude.
